blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Websters Corners fell from 14 in June to 8 in September (−42.9%), and 8 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.0% of Maple Ridge’s 410 houses listed.

blocks.text: Websters Corners home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Websters Corners with a median price of $1,042,500 (the middle half sold between $913,750 and $1,243,625), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $495 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 10,836 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Websters Corners?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 houses listed in Websters Corners. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Websters Corners a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Websters Corners had a sales ratio of 25% on only 8 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Websters Corners from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Websters Corners over those 4 months, out of 188 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Websters Corners?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Websters Corners sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Websters Corners between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,042,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Websters Corners?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
